summary: The fractal-web CI job restores a cached nix devShell closure instead of fetching the flake's inputs and building the shell's tools on every run.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CI-only change; the job falls back to nix develop .#web when the closure is not cached. No application, API or user-visible behavior change.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores nix develop .#web in the job; the cache entries expire on their own.
